pairs: In diebus illis surrexit Mathathias filius Joannis filii Simeonis,
In those days, there rose up Mattathias, the son of John,
sacerdos ex filiis Joarib, ab Jerusalem,
the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib from Jerusalem,
and he settled on the mountain of Modin.
hi viderunt mala, quæ fiebant in populo Juda, et in Jerusalem.
These saw the evils that were done among the people of Judah and in Jerusalem.
ut quid natus sum videre contritionem populi mei,
for why was I born to see the grief of my people
and the grief of the holy city,
while it is given into the hands of the enemies?
Sancta in manu extraneorum facta sunt:
The holy places have fallen into the hands of outsiders.
Her temple is like a man without honor.
Vasa gloriæ ejus captiva abducta sunt:
The vessels of her glory have been taken away captive.
trucidati sunt senes ejus in plateis,
Her old men have been butchered in the streets,
et juvenes ejus ceciderunt in gladio inimicorum.
and her young men have fallen by the sword of the enemies.
Quæ gens non hæreditavit regnum ejus et non obtinuit spolia ejus?
What nation has not inherited her kingdom and taken from her spoils?
All her beauty has been taken away.
et pulchritudo nostra, et claritas nostra desolata est,
and our beauty, and our splendor has been desolated,
and the Gentiles have defiled them.
Therefore, what is it to us that we still live?”
and his sons tore their garments,
and they covered themselves with haircloth,
Et venerunt illuc qui missi erant a rege Antiocho, ut cogerent eos,
And those who had been sent from king Antiochus came to that place,
qui confugerant in civitatem Modin, immolare,
to compel those who fled into the city of Modin to immolate,
and to depart from the law of God.
Et multi de populo Israël consentientes accesserunt ad eos:
And many of the people of Israel consented and came to them.
sed Mathathias et filii ejus constanter steterunt.
But Mattathias and his sons stood firm.
Et respondentes qui missi erant ab Antiocho,
And those who had been sent from Antiochus, responding,
Princeps, et clarissimus et magnus es in hac civitate,
“You are a ruler, and very splendid and great in this city,
and you are adorned with sons and brothers.
and carryout the order of the king,
as all the nations have done,
and those who remained in Jerusalem.
and your sons will be among the friends of the king,
and he said with a loud voice:
Etsi omnes gentes regi Antiocho obediunt,
“Even if all nations obey king Antiochus,
ut discedat unusquisque a servitute legis patrum suorum,
so that each one departs from the service of the law of his fathers
and my brothers will obey the law of our fathers.
May God be forgiving to us.
non est nobis utile relinquere legem,
It is not useful for us to abandon the law
We will not listen to the words of king Antiochus,
nec sacrificabimus transgredientes legis nostræ mandata,
nor will we sacrifice, transgressing the commandments of our law,
so as to set out on another way.”
Et ut cessavit loqui verba hæc,
And, as he ceased speaking these words,
accessit quidam Judæus in omnium oculis sacrificare idolis super aram in civitate Modin,
a certain Jew approached in the sight of all to sacrifice to the idols upon the altar in the city of Modin,
according to the order of the king.
And Mattathias saw, and he grieved,
et accensus est furor ejus secundum judicium legis,
and his fury was enkindled according to the judgment of the law,
et insiliens trucidavit eum super aram:
and leaping up, he slaughtered him on the altar.
the man whom king Antiochus had sent,
he killed at the same time,
and he was zealous for the law,
sicut fecit Phinees Zamri filio Salomi.
just as Phinehas did to Zimri, the son of Salomi.
Et exclamavit Mathathias voce magna in civitate,
And Mattathias exclaimed with a loud voice in the city,
“All who hold zeal for the law,
and his sons fled to the mountains,
et reliquerunt quæcumque habebant in civitate.
and they left behind whatever they had in the city.
Tunc descenderunt multi quærentes judicium, et justitiam, in desertum:
Then many who sought judgment and justice went down into the desert.
And it was reported to the king’s men,
et exercitui qui erat in Jerusalem civitate David,
and to the army that was in Jerusalem, in the city of David,
quoniam discessissent viri quidam, qui dissipaverunt mandatum regis,
that certain men, who had cast aside the commandment of the king,
had departed into the hidden places in the desert,
and that many had followed after them.
And immediately, they went out to them,
et constituerunt adversus eos prælium in die sabbatorum,
and they arranged a battle against them, on the day of the Sabbath.
et facite secundum verbum regis Antiochi,
Go out and act according to the word of king Antiochus,
and we will not do the king’s word,
so as to profane the day of the Sabbath.”
And they rushed against them in battle.
nor did they cast a stone at them,
nor did they barricade the hidden places,
“Let us all die in our simplicity.
et testes erunt super nos cælum et terra,
And heaven and earth will testify for us,
So they carried out a battle on the Sabbath.
And they were put to death,
et pecora eorum usque ad mille animas hominum.
and their cattle, even to the number of a thousand souls of men.
Et cognovit Mathathias et amici ejus,
And Mattathias and his friends heard of it,
et luctum habuerunt super eos valde.
and they held a very great lamentation for them.
And every man said to his neighbor,
Si omnes fecerimus sicut fratres nostri fecerunt,
“If we all do just as our brothers have done,
et non pugnaverimus adversus gentes pro animabus nostris et justificationibus nostris,
and if we do not fight against the Gentiles for the sake of our lives and our justifications,
nunc citius disperdent nos a terra.
then they will quickly eradicate us from the earth.”
And they decided, on that day, saying:
Omnis homo, quicumque venerit ad nos in bello die sabbatorum,
who will come against us in warfare on the day of the Sabbath,
And we will not all die,
sicut mortui sunt fratres nostri in occultis.
like our brothers who were put to death in the hidden places.”
Tunc congregata est ad eos synagoga Assidæorum fortis viribus ex Israël,
Then there was assembled before them the synagogue of the Hasideans, strong men from Israel,
each one with a will for the law.
et omnes, qui fugiebant a malis, additi sunt ad eos,
And all those who fled from the evils added themselves to them,
et facti sunt illis ad firmamentum.
and they became a firmament to them.
And they gathered together an army,
et percusserunt peccatores in ira sua,
and they struck down the sinners in their wrath
et viros iniquos in indignatione sua:
and the wicked men in their indignation.
And the others fled to the nations,
Et circuivit Mathathias et amici ejus,
And Mattathias and his friends traveled around,
et circumciderunt pueros incircumcisos quotquot invenerunt in finibus Israël:
And they circumcised all the uncircumcised boys, whom they found within the limits of Israel,
And they pursued the sons of arrogance,
et prosperatum est opus in manibus eorum:
and the work was prosperous in their hands.
et obtinuerunt legem de manibus gentium,
And they obtained the law from the hands of the Gentiles,
and from the hands of the kings.
And they did not surrender the horn to the sinner.
Then the days drew near when Mattathias would die,
and he said to his sons:
and it is a time of overturning
and of the wrath of indignation.
et date animas vestras pro testamento patrum vestrorum,
and give your lives for the sake of the covenant of your fathers.
And call to mind the works of the fathers,
which they have done in their generations.
And you will receive great glory
Abraham nonne in tentatione inventus est fidelis,
Was not Abraham found to be faithful in temptation,
et reputatum est ei ad justitiam?
and so it was accounted to him as justice?
Joseph in tempore angustiæ suæ custodivit mandatum,
Joseph, in the time of his anguish, kept the commandment,
and he was made ruler of Egypt.
being zealous in the zeal of God,
received the covenant of an eternal priesthood.
Jesus, since he fulfilled the word,
was made a commander in Israel.
Caleb, since he testified in the assembly,
David in sua misericordia consecutus est sedem regni in sæcula.
David, in his mercy, obtained the throne of a kingdom for all generations.
since he was zealous with a zeal for the law,
Ananias et Azarias et Misaël credentes,
Hananiah and Azariah and Mishael, by believing,
Daniel in sua simplicitate liberatus est de ore leonum.
Daniel, in his simplicity, was delivered from the mouth of the lions.
quia omnes qui sperant in eum,
through generation after generation of all those who trusted in him,
Et a verbis viri peccatoris ne timueritis,
And fear not the words of a sinful man,
quia gloria ejus stercus et vermis est:
for his glory is dung and worms.
and tomorrow he will not be found,
quia conversus est in terram suam,
because he has returned into his earth
confortamini, et viriliter agite in lege:
be strengthened and act manfully in the law.
For by it, you shall become glorious.
I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel.
and he will be a father to you.
who has been strong and resourceful from his youth,
let him be the leader of your militia,
and he will manage the war of the people.
Et adducetis ad vos omnes factores legis:
And you shall add to yourselves all who observe the law,
and you shall claim the vindication of your people.
Render to the Gentiles their retribution,
and pay attention to the precepts of the law.”
et appositus est ad patres suos.
and he was added to his fathers.
And he passed away in the one hundred and forty-sixth year,
and he was buried by his sons in the sepulchers of his fathers,
et sepultus est a filiis suis in sepulchris patrum suorum in Modin,
et planxerunt eum omnis Israël planctu magno.
and all Israel mourned for him with a great mourning.
